H1700.def: feminine of «01697»; a reason, suit or style:--cause, end, estate, order, regard.

H1702.def: feminine active participle of «01696» in the sense of driving (compare «01699»); a raft:--float.

H1705.def: from «01697» (perhaps in the sense of «01699»); Daberath, a place in Palestine:--Dabareh, Daberath.

H1706.et: from an unused root meaning to be gummy
H1706.def: from an unused root meaning to be gummy; honey (from its stickiness); by analogy, syrup:--honey((-comb)).

H1707.def: intensive from the same as «01706»; a sticky mass, i.e. the hump of a camel:--hunch (of a camel).

H1708.def: the same as «01707»; Dabbesheth, a place in Palestine:--Dabbesheth.

H1709.def: or (fully) dag (Nehemiah 13:16) {dawg}; from «01711»; a fish (as prolific); or perhaps rather from «01672» (as timid); but still better from «01672» (in the sense of squirming, i.e. moving by the vibratory action of the tail); a fish (often used collectively):--fish.

H1710.def: feminine of «01709», and meaning the same:--fish.

H1711.def: a primitive root; to move rapidly; used only as a denominative from «01709»; to spawn, i.e. become numerous:--grow.

H1712.def: from «01709»; the fish-god; Dagon, a Philistine deity:--Dagon.

H1713.def: a primitive root; to flaunt, i.e. raise a flag; figuratively, to be conspicuous:--(set up, with) banners, chiefest.

H1715.def: from «01711»; properly, increase, i.e. grain:--corn ((floor)), wheat.

H1716.def: a primitive root, to brood over eggs or young:--gather, sit.

H1717.def: apparently from the same as «01730»; the breast (as the seat of love, or from its shape):--breast, teat.

H1718.def: a doubtful root; to walk gently:--go (softly, with).

H1719.def: or (prolonged) Ddaneh (Ezek. 25:13) {deh-daw'- neh}; of uncertain derivation; Dedan, the name of two Cushites and of their territory:--Dedan.

H1720.def: plural of «01719» (as patrial); Dedanites, the descendants or inhabitants of Dedan:--Dedanim.

H1721.def: or (by orthographical error) Rodaniym (1 Chron. 1:7) {ro-daw-neem'}; a plural of uncertain derivation; Dodanites, or descendants of a son of Javan:--Dodanim.

H1723.def: (Aramaic) of uncertain derivation; Dahava, a people colonized in Samaria:--Dehavites.

H1724.def: a primitive root (compare «01740»); to be dumb, i.e. (figuratively) dumbfounded:--astonished.

H1725.def: a primitive root; to curvet or move irregularly:--pause.

H1727.def: a primitive root; to mope, i.e. (figuratively) pine:-- sorrow.

H1728.et: an orthographical variation of (01709) as a denominative [(01771)]
H1728.def: an orthographical variation of «01709» as a denominative («01771»); a fisherman:--fisher.

H1729.def: feminine from the same as «01728»; properly, fishery, i.e. a hook for fishing:--fish (hook).

H1730.et: from an unused root meaning properly, to boil
H1730.def: or (shortened) dod {dode}; from an unused root meaning properly, to boil, i.e. (figuratively) to love; by implication, a love- token, lover, friend; specifically an uncle:--(well-)beloved, father's brother, love, uncle.

H1731.def: from the same as «01730»; a pot (for boiling); also (by resemblance of shape) a basket:--basket, caldron, kettle, (seething) pot.

H1732.def: rarely (fully); Daviyd {daw-veed'}; from the same as «01730»; loving; David, the youngest son of Jesse:--David.

H1733.def: feminine of «01730»; an aunt:--aunt, father's sister, uncle's wife.

H1734.def: from «01730»; loving; Dodo, the name of three Israelites:--Dodo.

H1735.def: from «01730» and «03050»; love of Jah; Dodavah, an Israelite:--Dodavah.

H1736.def: from «01731»; a boiler or basket; also the mandrake (as an aphrodisiac):--basket, mandrake.

H1737.def: formed like «01736»; amatory; Dodai, an Israelite:--Dodai.

H1738.def: a primitive root; to be sick (as if in menstruation):--infirmity.

H1739.def: from «01738»; sick (especially in menstruation):--faint, menstruous cloth, she that is sick, having sickness.

H1740.def: a primitive root; to thrust away; figuratively, to cleanse:--cast out, purge, wash.

H1743.def: a primitive root; to bruise in a mortar:--beat.

H1744.def: of uncertain derivation; the hoopoe or else the grouse:--lapwing.

H1745.et: from an unused root meaning to be dumb (compare (1820))
H1745.def: from an unused root meaning to be dumb (compare «01820»); silence; figuratively, death:--silence.

H1746.def: the same as «01745»; Dumah, a tribe and region of Arabia:--Dumah.

H1747.def: from «01820»; stillness; adverbially, silently; abstractly quiet, trust:--silence, silent, waiteth.

H1748.def: from «01826»; still; adverbially, silently:--dumb, silent, quietly wait.

H1750.def: a primitive root; to leap:--be turned.

H1751.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «01854»; to crumble:--be broken to pieces.

H1752.def: a primitive root; properly, to gyrate (or move in a circle), i.e. to remain:--dwell.

H1754.def: from «01752»; a circle, ball or pile:--ball, turn, round about.

H1755.def: or (shortened) dor {dore}; from «01752»; properly, a revolution of time, i.e. an age or generation; also a dwelling:--age, × evermore, generation, (n-)ever, posterity.

H1756.def: or (by permutation) Dorr (Josh. 17:11; 1 Kings 4:11) {dore}; from «01755»; dwelling; Dor, a place in Palestine:--Dor.

H1757.def: (Aramaic) probably from «01753»; circle or dwelling; Dura, a place in Babylonia:--Dura.

H1758.def: or dowsh {dosh}; or diysh {deesh}; a primitive root; to trample or thresh:--break, tear, thresh, tread out (down), at grass (Jer. 50:11, by mistake for «01877»).

H1760.def: or dachach {Jer. 23:12) {daw-khakh'}; a primitive root; to push down:--chase, drive away (on), overthrow, outcast, × sore, thrust, totter.

H1761.def: (Aramaic) from the equivalent of «01760»; probably a musical instrument (as being struck):--instrument of music.

H1762.def: from «01760»; a push, i.e. (by implication) a fall:--falling.

H1763.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «02119»; to slink, i.e. (by implication) to fear, or (causatively) be formidable:--make afraid, dreadful, fear, terrible.

H1765.def: a primitive root; to urge, i.e. hasten:--(be) haste(-ned), pressed on.

H1766.def: a primitive root; to press, i.e. oppress:--thrust, vex.

H1767.def: of uncertain derivation; enough (as noun or adverb), used chiefly with preposition in phrases:--able, according to, after (ability), among, as (oft as), (more than) enough, from, in, since, (much as is) sufficient(-ly), too much, very, when.

H1768.def: (Aramaic) apparently for «01668»; that, used as relative conjunction, and especially (with a preposition) in adverbial phrases; also as preposition of:--X as, but, for(-asmuch +), + now, of, seeing, than, that, therefore, until, + what (-soever), when, which, whom, whose.

H1769.def: or (shortened) Diybon {dee-bone'}; from «01727»; pining:--Dibon, the name of three places in Palestine:--Dibon. (Also, with «01410» added, Dibon-gad.)

H1772.def: intensive from «01675»; a falcon (from its rapid flight):--vulture.

H1774.def: as if from «01768» and «02091»; of gold; Dizahab, a place in the Desert:--Dizahab.

H1775.def: perhaps for «01769»; Dimon, a place in Palestine:--Dimon.

H1776.def: feminine of «01775»; Dimonah, a place in Palestine:--Dimonah.

H1777.def: or (Gen. 6:3) duwn {doon}; a primitive roy a straight course, i.e. sail direct:--(come) with a straight course.

H1778.def: (Aramaic) corresp. to «01777»; to judge:--judge. Or diyn, {deen}; or (Job 19:29).

H1779.def: from «01777»; judgement (the suit, justice, sentence or tribunal); by impl. also strife:--cause, judgement, plea, strife.

H1783.def: fem. of «01779»; justice; Dinah, the daughter of Jacob:--Dinah.

H1784.def: (Aramaic) partial from uncertain primitive; a Dinaite or inhabitant of some unknown Assyria province:--Dinaite.

H1785.def: from a root corresp. to «01751»; a battering-tower:--fort.

H1787.def: (Diyshon, the same as «01788»; Dishon, the name of two Edomites:--Dishon.

H1788.def: from «01758»; the leaper, i.e. an antelope:--pygarg.

H1789.def: another form of «01787» Dishan, an Edomite:--Dishon.

H1790.def: from an unused root (compare «01794»); crushed, i.e. (fig.) injured:--afflicted, oppressed.

H1791.def: (Aramaic) or dak (Aramaic) {dawk}; prolonged from «01668»; this:--the same, this.

H1792.def: a primitive root (compare «01794»); to crumble; transitively, to bruise (literally or figuratively):--beat to pieces, break (in pieces), bruise, contrite, crush, destroy, humble, oppress, smite.

H1793.def: from «01792»; crushed (literally powder, or figuratively, contrite):--contrite, destruction.

H1794.def: a primitive root (compare «01790», «01792»); to collapse (phys. or mentally):--break (sore), contrite, crouch.

H1798.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «02145»; properly, a male, i.e. of sheep:--ram.

H1799.def: (Aramaic) or dokran {dok-rawn'} (Aramaic); corresponding to «02146»; a register:--record.
